label: XDCR Collation Comparison
type: the ordering-based procedure XDCR filtering uses to compare values of differing data types by their relative position in the supported-data-types list, alongside xdcr:data-type-conversion. Equality between two differing data types always evaluates false.
evidence: Magnitude comparison between different data types is resolved in accordance with the respective positions of the data types in the list of Supported Data Types.
Checking for equality between different data types returns false.
relates_to_competency_question: Can an XDCR filter expression's greater-than/less-than comparison ever succeed across two different data types, and can equality?
